title: Spicy Cauliflower Fritters with Pea Shoots

ingredients.raw: 7 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, plus more as needed for frying
ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil

ingredients.raw: Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
ingredients.name: kosher salt and black pepper

ingredients.raw: 3 ounces pea shoots, arugula, watercress, or sprouts of your choice (about 4 cups)
ingredients.name: pea shoots

ingredients.raw: 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice (from 1/2 medium lemon)
ingredients.name: fresh lemon juice

ingredients.raw: Tamarind sauce, preferably Maggi, for serving
ingredients.name: tamarind sauce

instructions.text: In a large nonstick skillet set over medium heat, cook the onion in 3 tablespoons of the olive oil with the curry, cayenne, salt, and black pepper. Cook until wilted, about 2 minutes, stirring often, then add the cauliflower. Continue to cook until everything has softened, about 3 minutes more. Scrape the mixture into a large bowl and let cool for 5 minutes, then mix in the eggs, panko, flour, chives, peas, and more salt and pepper.

Add another 3 tablespoons of the olive oil to the skillet and set over medium-high heat. Spoon a drop of batter into the skillet to make sure the oil is hot enough—you want it to sizzle—then fry 1/4-cup scoops of the cauliflower mixture in the oil, flattening each to make fritters. Fry until golden and cooked, about 2 minutes on each side. Transfer the fritters to a large paper-towel-lined platter and tent with foil to keep warm. Repeat with the remaining mixture, adding more oil for frying as needed.

When all the fritters have been cooked, toss the pea shoots with the lemon juice and the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a bowl, then place them on top of the fritters. Serve with plain yogurt and tamarind sauce on the side.
